Tropical Island Holiday | Dave Parker Eco Lodge Hotel| Tapatapao, Alesa East, Samoa
top of page
"Experience Samoa's Tropical Ecology Right at Your Doorstep"
A Journey Into the Heart of Nature
This unique mountain top Hotel is located on the tropical hillside of Tapatapa'o, surrounded by bird life, vegetation and waterfalls. Known for its breathtaking views, creates the perfect atmosphere for a peaceful, relaxing holiday. Witness some of the most amazing sunrises and sunsets across the P acific Ocean and the magical world of stars at night.
​
​ (Children 12-years and over are welcome)

Rooms
Balcony View with Aircon
Our double room features a queen bed & a single bed with an ensuite bathroom and kitchenette. Equipped with tea/coffee making facilities, microwave, jug and a small fridge. A private balcony with sea & mountain views.
Book Now
Deluxe Studio Suite with Aircon
Newly decorated open plan studio. Features a double bed and ensuite. Kitchenette equipped with microwave, jug and small fridge. Enjoy the private large patio with extensive views of the ocean & rainforest. Cooler climate, peaceful, mindfulness.
Book Now
Hilltop Lodge
Our fan-cooled double room features a queen bed & a single bed with an ensuite bathroom. Kitchenette comes with a microwave, jug and small fridge. Our rooms look out towards the ocean and rainforest with a covered patio for outdoor seating.
Book Now
Hilltop Lodge with Aircon
Our double room features a queen bed & a single bed and an ensuite bathroom. The kitchenette has a microwave, jug and small fridge.
Aircon for comfort.
Bush & rainforest views.

Hilltop Studio
Our fan-cooled studio features a queen bed with an ensuite bathroom and kitchenette. Equipped with a microwave, jug and a small fridge.
A small private balcony with
sea & mountain views.
Book Now
Hilltop Studio with Aircon
This end room studio features a queen bed with ensuite bathroom. Equipped with a microwave, jug and a small fridge. A small private balcony with ocean and rainforest views.
Aircon for comfort.
Book Now
Private Executive Suite with Aircon
This superior suite boasts space, privacy & peace. Top level with extensive views on 3-sides, this truly is a home away from home. Purposely put, one queen bed with large bathroom and shower. Kitchen with microwave, jug, toaster and full-size fridge. Two hot plates for light cooking. Dining suite and two large comfy couches. Large private balcony with extensive views.
Book Now
Swimming Pool
Cool down in our swimming pool or two waterfalls on site. Enjoy a meal at our onsite Restaurant & Bar or lounge around on the deck watching the birds or reading a book.
See you soon.

ABOUT US | Dave Parker Eco Lodge Samoa
top of page
ABOUT US
Dave Parker Eco Lodge Hotel ​
​ Built and operated by a Visionary - Dave Parker
(one of Samoa's great International Singers). ​
Born and raised on the Parker Estate, Dave built an exclusive Hotel with a gateway to hidden treasures of the natural world. An invitation is extended to those booked to stay, may discover and enjoy the natural surroundings, waterfalls and bird life this private land has to offer.
​
Our hotel boasts 15 rooms, each with a view of the ocean, rainforest and mountains. 11 of the rooms provide air-conditioning for comfort, but being high on top of the hillside, the climate is much cooler.
​
Our onsite Restaurant balcony opens out to one of the best extensive views Samoa has to offer.
Try some traditional or International cuisines, including some gluten free, diary free and vegan options.
Every Sunday we cook a tradition open fire dish - Umu, (on hot rocks) for lunch.
Guests are encouraged to interact and enjoy the experience with our staff.
The Parker family's dedication to preservation and protection of our history, environment and bird life has continued for 3-generations so far.
​
​ We live in an unspoiled rainforest and want to keep it that way, so our guests can enjoy nature at its best!
​ ​ ​ ​
Umu Making
WHAT PEOPLE SAY
Sophia, Australia
"The view is spectacular and the place it self . Had the best time , the owner very friendly and the workers . I'll go again and stay there."
Regina, Australia
"I loved the privacy, it was clean the service was great, I just loved the view over Apia.."
​
​
Hannah, New Zealand
A great place to acclimatise to the samoa heat... up in the cool mountains..We loved the location, close to Apia to get supplies and visit the market, but set In beautiful forest views and nice gardens, a good walk and swim down to the little waterfall and swimming hole, kind owner and workers, clean rooms, basic in room facilities for all you need! Great breakfast! Nice clean pool and a friendly puppies!
Jane, New Zealand
Great view for nature lovers and those who want to see a different type of Samoa. Good value for money and great service.
Taio, Samoa
Had an amazing view. Nice and quiet. The owner was very friendly and the surrounding was clean. It's an amazing place to distress, relax and get away from city life.
